title: LBW-Guard：大语言模型训练的边界自主控制治理层
summary: 本文提出LBW-Guard，一种位于优化器之上的边界自主训练控制治理层，通过观察训练遥测并施加边界控制，提升LLM训练的稳定性与效率。在Qwen2.5-7B上，困惑度从13.21降至10.74（提升18.7%），训练时间加速1.10倍。在高学习率压力下，AdamW训练崩溃，而LBW-Guard仍保持可训练状态。
summary_en: This paper proposes LBW-Guard, a bounded autonomous training control governance layer above the optimizer. It improves LLM training stability and efficiency by observing telemetry and applying bounded control. On Qwen2.5-7B, perplexity drops from 13.21 to 10.74 (18.7% improvement) with 1.10x speedup. Under high learning rate stress, AdamW fails while LBW-Guard remains trainable.
